# Step 3.6 Plot Figure 6B

Load library and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/6B_relative-enhancer-frequency-mm10.tsv") 
```



Plot relative enhancer frequency around genes (genome-wide)
```{r}
df_genowide <- df %>%
  filter(background == "genome_wide") %>%
  mutate(
    x = if_else(
      side == "Start",
      -30 - distance_midpoint_kb,
      30 + distance_midpoint_kb
    )
  )

p_geno <- df_genowide %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = relative_frequency, group = side)) +
  # highlight the gene body
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -30, xmax = 30,
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  # expected background frequency (relative frequency = 1)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0, y = 0.15,
           label = "Gene", size = 4) +
  # label distances relative to gene Start and End
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-230, -130, -30, 30, 130, 230),
    labels = c("-200", "-100", "Start", "End", "100", "200")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-240, 240)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 6B reanalysis (genome-wide)",
    x = "Distance from gene (kb)",
    y = "Relative enhancer frequency"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_geno
```

Plot relative enhancer frequency around genes (intergenic-only)
```{r}
df_intergenic <- df %>%
  filter(background == "intergenic_only") %>%
  mutate(
    x = if_else(
      side == "Start",
      -30 - distance_midpoint_kb,
      30 + distance_midpoint_kb
    )
  )

p_inter <- df_intergenic %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = relative_frequency, group = side)) +
  # highlight the gene body
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -30, xmax = 30,
           ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  # expected background frequency (relative frequency = 1)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0, y = 0.15,
           label = "Gene", size = 4) +
  # label distances relative to gene Start and End
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-230, -130, -30, 30, 130, 230),
    labels = c("-200", "-100", "Start", "End", "100", "200")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-240, 240)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 6B reanalysis (intergenic-only)",
    x = "Distance from gene (kb)",
    y = "Relative enhancer frequency"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_inter
```
Save the result
```{r}
# Save the plot
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6B_genomewide.png",
       plot = p_geno,
       width = 8,
       height = 5)
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6B_intergeniconly.png",
       plot = p_inter,
       width = 8,
       height = 5)

# Save the summary data

summary_df <- df %>%
  select(
    background,
    side,
    distance_start_bp,
    distance_end_bp,
    distance_midpoint_kb,
    observed_count,
    expected_count,
    observed_frequency,
    expected_frequency,
    relative_frequency
  )

write_tsv(
  summary_df,
  "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6B_summary.tsv"
)

```
